_comment: Crash families zonecraft knows. Each rule's regex is matched (case-insensitive) against the crash's error message plus call stack; the first match names the family. Add a rule when a crash is understood (knowledge/animation.md § Crash families, knowledge/diagnostics.md).

rules.advice: The crash is inside UE4SS. Turn dev probes off in ue4ss/Mods/mods.txt (a probe left reading a mod's actor crashed the game after a release) and retest.
Known crash family: native code keeps the anim instance it made at spawn. Do not swap the player's anim class; use linked layers or montages (animation.md).
Known crash family: SetOverridePostProcessAnimBP with Reinit=true. Only the single swap at load is safe (animation.md).

rules.family: Post-process swap during a native interaction
rules.advice: Known crash family: swapping the post-process anim instance while a contextual action runs. Do not swap during play (animation.md).

rules.family: State machine query outside the anim update
rules.advice: Known crash family: querying a state machine from outside the anim update faults. Read state from the anim graph instead.

rules.family: Linking a game posture layer outside its native flow
rules.advice: Known crash family (animation.md): do not link AnimBP_Player_TwoHandedItem or other game postures from a mod.

rules.match: BrokenGameData|can't find SID|links on empty|invalid .* placeholder
rules.family: Broken game data (a quest or cfg points at something missing)
rules.advice: Read <kit>/Stalker2/Saved/BrokenGameData and QuestBrokenGameData, fix the node or cfg it names, check SIDs with gamedata.py (quests.md § Debugging quests).
An engine check failed; the line after 'Assertion failed' names the condition and source file. Look for the mod asset it mentions.
Not a known family yet. Note what the player was doing, read the stack (diagnostics.md § Reading a crash) and, if needed, park the dev pak for a control test.
